bounds_role: Numerical search ranges for effective positive scales and dimensionless length slopes; not measured material bounds.
objective: Original 100/300/500 mm calibration records only, with the existing displacement-interval weights and per-curve peak normalization; equal weights among these three curves.
initialization_basis: Calibration-only local shape diagnostics motivate short-length delayed onset and long-length gradual mobilization; all twelve length coefficients are refitted jointly to response curves.
method_change_reason: Test whether a continuous geometry-conditioned shape law retains the calibrated plateau and principal long-anchor peak while transferring to 200/400 mm. Keep the finite-depth recovery and diminishing-contact hypotheses, replace forced width proportionality by a fitted positive power, and allow a log-length trend in residual fraction. The onset decays exponentially with length and mobilization has its own positive length power. These are effective response hypotheses within 100-500 mm, not measured material trends.
compliance_role: Fix the completed local-diagnostic compliance to isolate length sharing from the already established C/K ambiguity. The value is not an apparatus measurement.
